segments.text: Now next sutra. I see chastra, sushakti pratyose visham for such master, this whole universe.
Visham, this whole universe is for him. I say for him sushakti pratyahya. Sumu. Sumu means
collection. Collectivity, collectivity of his own energies. All collective energies are found
in universe. He perceives that this whole universe is the embodiment of his collective energies.
Universe is not separate from his collective energies. Unimitable, corrective energies.
Can you understand? Yoyam shivatulya uhta. That master, as he is said to be just like Shiva.
So, sushaktiose jagatrasma, his energies are this whole universe. This whole universe is his collective energy.
It is the amna-idrsteya, by this saying, shivasiya visham sushakti mayam. For Shiva, this whole universe
is nothing than his energy. Tatha asyapi, sasya, samis-asmana, sakti, prajiya, kriya, sakti,
sufrana, rupa, vikasa, visham. In the same way, not only for Shiva, this universe is the collection
of his energies. For Yogi, also, this universe, because Yogi is one with that samis-atma, one with
that god consciousness. So, for Yogi, also, this universe is his collective energy, combination
of collective energies. Expansion of his energies. Yaduhtam shri Mretijati, it is said in Mretinjay
Bhatharaka. As this Lord Shiva is filled with knowledge, and that knowledge is innumerable. Knowledge
is knowledge of part, knowledge of bhukhari, knowledge of kongri, knowledge of one person,
another person, second person, third person, nentritanam, baddhanam, tranam, tatne tramujati.
So this knowledge is innumerable knowledge, found in this universe. Universal knowledge is
real knowledge. And that knowledge, which relieves you from limited knowledge of universe, is
really natra, is called natra. Nentritanam tranam, natra means the one who is bound in particular
knowledge, particular class of knowledge. For instance, I am bound in particular class of knowledge,
particular mass of knowledge. I am not bound in universal knowledge. I have
bound in particular class of knowledge. For instance, I have bound in this house, in that house,
in this garden, in bank balance, in Gopinath, Shariqa, Prabha, you, in everybody, my disciples.
So it is Niyan Tritana.
I am bound in one particular in a class, but the master who reveals you, reveals you the universal truth.
After revealing that universal truth, you come out of that limitation.
And the whole universe becomes your, you know, possession.
You possess the whole universe, then you are freed.
Otherwise, if there is only limitation out of this universe,
you pick up only a class out of this universe and hold, hold and possess that.
That is ignorance.
If you possess this whole universe as your own self, then you are liberated.
This is what is meant in this Shloka of Niyatritana.
This knowledge is found inside and outside everywhere.
Because Gana Tritana, without knowledge, object cannot exist.
Any object cannot exist without knowledge.
So, this whole universe is filled with that knowledge.
And that knowledge, if it is object to knowledge, never mind.
That object to knowledge is, in fact, knowledge of God consciousness.
Nobody has perceived any object without that knowledge.
Gana Mta Taha Mata Amyatam, that knowledge, the real knowledge of God consciousness has taken the formation of objects.
Object to knowledge is not separate from that knowledge of God consciousness.
Atas Mata Awasi Yetai, by that knowledge of God consciousness,
this knowledge of objects takes place.
Astina Asti Vibhagina Niseyade Vidyogata.
When you put this yoga, this yoga that God consciousness is to be possessed
and other than God consciousness is to be discarded.
Object to consciousness is to be discarded and God consciousness is to be possessed.
When you do such kind of Niseyade and Vidy, having and disowning.
But you must have, you must have God consciousness.
What you must disown, you must disown object to consciousness.
But this is not the real way of understanding.
The real way of understanding is, you must unite them with each other.
God consciousness must be united with object to consciousness.
And object to consciousness must be one with God consciousness.
Then you are realized.
Then the real nature has revealed to you.
Gana Mata Aganishta, this reality of knowledge, reality of God consciousness,
is established in object to world.
It is not separate from object to world.
Because Bhavanam, Bhavanambala, all these objects are found in one with God consciousness by meditation.
As long as you meditate upon that and be aware that this object to world is not separate from God consciousness,
it will be just like God consciousness.
So you won't find any difference between God consciousness and object to consciousness.
Yukupatve Dhanath Gana Geyi, your A-groupada,
when you simultaneously know this kind of knowledge, then knowledge and known will be not separated.
Knowledge and known, won't be known separated.
Known will become knowledge, knowledge will become known.
I think you also understand.
